tpl.structured.label: Standard Structured Rule (Trigger + MUST + NEVER + Format)
tpl.structured.title: Structured Behavioral Rule
tpl.structured.content:
**Scope / Trigger**: When performing code changes or answering technical questions
**Core Requirements (MUST)**:
1. State the core conclusion or root cause first before expanding details.
2. Verify edge cases and preserve existing public API compatibility.
**Prohibitions (NEVER)**:
- NEVER introduce unrequested dependencies or modify unrelated files.
**Output Format**:
- Use concise Markdown bullet points and link referenced workspace files.
tpl.languageStyle.label: Default Language & Concise Communication Style
tpl.languageStyle.title: Language & Communication Style
tpl.languageStyle.content:
**Core Requirements (MUST)**:
1. Always reply in Simplified Chinese (简体中文) unless the user explicitly requests another language.
2. Lead with the direct answer or conclusion; avoid filler intros and repetitive summaries.
**Prohibitions (NEVER)**:
- NEVER omit technical precision when summarizing.
tpl.codeQuality.label: Project Coding Standards & Mandatory Test Verification
tpl.codeQuality.title: Code Quality & Verification Rules
tpl.codeQuality.content:
**Scope / Trigger**: Whenever modifying source files in this workspace
**Core Requirements (MUST)**:
1. Follow the existing architectural boundaries and naming conventions of the repository.
2. Run the corresponding unit test suite after any code edit and verify all tests pass before finishing.
**Prohibitions (NEVER)**:
- NEVER claim a fix is complete without checking test exit codes.
tpl.readOnlyDesign.label: Read-Only Analysis / Design Proposal Only (No File Edits)
tpl.readOnlyDesign.title: Read-Only Design Mode Constraint
tpl.readOnlyDesign.content:
**Core Requirements (MUST)**:
1. Inspect relevant interfaces and source files in read-only mode.
2. Output a structured architectural design and implementation plan only.
**Prohibitions (NEVER)**:
- NEVER create, edit, or delete workspace files until the user explicitly approves implementation.
agentScopeAll: All Agents (Main + Subagents, Recommended · Preserves KV Cache)
agentScopeMain: Main Agent Only (Top-level session only, skipped in Subagents)
agentScopeSubagent: Subagents Only (Injected only into delegated child Subagents)
